values.task_boundary: Implement only the WP-18B provider-neutral harness, validator, proof matrix, traces, and failure cases over landed #5832, #5834, and #5836 contracts.
deliverables: Provider-neutral matrix with at least two positive columns
Redacted ACIP traces and artifact digests
Malformed, denied, interrupted, unavailable, loss, and substitution proof
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: At least two real providers complete the identical versioned scenario through equivalent ACIP operations.
AC-2: Provider identity/capability truth and bounded semantic differences are retained without credentials or private payloads.
AC-3: Malformed, denied, interrupted, unavailable, provider-loss, and substitution cases have visible non-pass outcomes.
AC-4: One provider failure leaves Runtime and unrelated agents available, with macOS/Linux tooling posture recorded.
AC-5: Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable finding.
dependencies: Two approved real-provider credential sources available at execution time
non_goals: Changing ACIP or the birthday scenario
Publishing credentials, private prompts, or raw payloads
